_comment: Deep-dive film catalogue. To add a film: (1) upload it to YouTube, (2) drop a short muted-loop preview .mp4 in this folder, (3) add an object below. No code changes needed. Set "youtube" to the 11-char video id; leave "" to show preview-only. "preview" is optional.

films.title: Seahorse Valley
films.blurb: A descent into the seahorse-tailed filaments threading the cleft between the main cardioid and the period-2 bulb — self-similar spirals all the way down.

films.title: From Elephant Valley to a Pod
films.blurb: Out along the elephant-trunk valley on the cardioid's right flank, marching through herds of trunks toward a hidden mini-Mandelbrot pod.

films.title: Always Connected
films.blurb: However thin the filaments grow, the set never breaks apart — a visual meditation on Douady & Hubbard's theorem that the Mandelbrot set is connected.
